panels.description: Alex removes a corroded cover beneath the misleading gauge. Keep the upper cover area clear.
Inside rests the compact brass Measure, its engraved collar visible. Keep the upper instrument area clear.
Alex lifts the Measure and its three arms unfold. Keep the upper chamber clear.
The Measure rejects the official data line and locks onto the analog gauge while B11 watches. Keep the upper gauge clear.

items.text: WHAT IS NOT MEASURED CAN BE MADE INVISIBLE
